The last time I have seen Adolf Wilhelm was in Obytchikova Rastreblezheniya (Yakuschuk's Embankment).
This is the last fact. The day before his death Michel said that he hoped to live another day and then to visit the same place with his adopted son and to see the beloved places on that place.
